name: RustFS
tagline: High-performance S3-compatible object storage built in Rust
description: RustFS is a high-performance, distributed object storage system built in Rust. It combines the simplicity of MinIO with the memory safety and raw performance of Rust. It offers full S3 compatibility, is completely open-source under Apache 2.0 license, and is optimized for data lakes, AI, and big data workloads.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Rustfs access key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Rustfs secret key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: rustfs/rustfs:1.0.0-alpha.71@sha256:5ed6b4845ff98d44d42f733324761dc1379a8c36b7ee66c25e2dc3e8cbe0280d
    container_name: rustfs
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:9000"
      - "9001:9001"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/data
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/logs:/logs
    environment:
      - RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY=${SECRET_RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY}
      - RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY=${SECRET_RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY}
      - RUSTFS_CONSOLE_ENABLE=true
      - RUSTFS_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0:9000
      - RUSTFS_CONSOLE_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0:9001
      - TZ=UTC
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "sh", "-c", "curl -f http://localhost:9000/health && curl -f http://localhost:9001/rustfs/console/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
